summary_1line: Janamejaya asks about Yayati and Devayani; the tale begins with Kacha serving Sukra to learn resurrection, repeatedly slain by Asuras but revived by his teacher.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kacha emerges alive from the torn stomach of Sukra like the rising moon, while the sage’s body lies on the ground of the hermitage.
Devayani anxiously watches the cows return at sunset without Kacha, standing beside the sacrificial fire before her father Sukra.
Asuras in a dark forest kill Kacha and scatter his hacked body to jackals and wolves beneath a banyan tree.
